description: Multiple files: Two files read, one modified externally, system retries entire turn
prompt:
1. Read TWO files:
<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/config.js"}
</context-item>

<context-item use="read-file">
{"path": "src/utils.js"}
</context-item>

2. After both context items are created, edit config.js using replace-text:
<action execute="replace-text">
{"path": "src/config.js", "old_str": "export const API_URL = 'https://api.example.com';", "new_str": "export const API_URL = 'https://updated.com';"}
</action>

NOTE: utils.js will be modified externally. Even though you're only editing config.js, the system should detect utils.js changed and retry the entire turn.

3. After observing the behavior, write your findings to TEST_RESULTS.md. Document that a Retry occurred due to external file changes.
